Professional system · construction operations

Inventory Verification Portal

A role-based workflow that turns equipment inventory reviews into owned assignments, structured exceptions, signed decisions, and traceable history.

  • RoleWorkflow design & full-stack development
  • TechnologyReact · TypeScript · Fastify · Azure SQL
  • ContextProfessional work at Graham

The problem

Annual equipment reviews begin with a large source workbook, then move through location-specific follow-up, email replies, and several groups responsible for exceptions. A spreadsheet can store the inventory but does not make ownership, sign-off, or unresolved work easy to see.

Approach

I translated the process into a role-based web workflow. The portal validates a source workbook, assigns project and yard reviews, supports verification and structured exceptions, records sign-off snapshots, and maintains audit history for campaign reporting.

Key decisions

  • Match records and actions to the user’s role and location.
  • Keep source links and signed snapshots so later corrections do not rewrite history.
  • Route exceptions as structured work rather than leaving decisions buried in email.
  • Use Python file-preparation tools to make controlled source handling repeatable.

What it demonstrates

Turning a multi-owner operational process into software that makes accountability and progress visible without oversimplifying the difficult cases.
